change: A shorter map: past the next realm to open, the sealed realms wait behind one line that counts and names them

mutations.name: the next sealed realm is folded too
the fold drops its last realm
mutations.find:
const p=(parts||[]).filter(x=>x&&String(x).trim());
    if(p.length<2) return p.join('');   // one alone is shown, not folded
mutations.replace:
const p=(parts||[]).filter(x=>x&&String(x).trim()).slice(0,-1);
    if(p.length<2) return p.join('');   // one alone is shown, not folded

mutations.name: the fold forgets it was opened
a stone no longer opens the fold
mutations.find: if(fold){ fold.open=true; SealFold.open=true; }   // a sealed realm further on is reached through its fold

mutations.name: the next sealed realm is folded too, seen in play
a stone no longer opens the fold, seen in play
mutations.find: if(fold){ fold.open=true; SealFold.open=true; }   // a sealed realm further on is reached through its fold
